coordinator#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5o9i6CYnwYoQTC2LNd

Ruling: letter A · maintainer 「A 关卡,不改代码」 · 2026-11-22T03:19Z
Ruling-ref: decision thread `cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XEPGEsUErPnbj7HR3iM4NdN`, decision card `cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X5j5PRKxDnKBaG1kSQEsdsQ`, choice record `cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XMs9noWe3nEaAW2bKPb4ry5` (the maintainer's tap, 2026-11-22T03:18:19Z). It answers the open question of os-dev-report 7073331953.
Governing text: `ui/apps/console/index.html` (the `installInsecureOriginRandomUuid` inline script and its comment, objectui#4563), pinned by `ui/apps/console/src/__tests__/insecure-origin-crypto.test.ts` and `insecure-origin-crypto.placement.test.ts`. No ADR or AGENTS.md line on the subject.

## 维护者速读

- 问题:卡片说用普通 http 地址打开系统时,点列表表头排序会报错、排不了。实测已发布的产品没有这个症状。
- 裁定:附上实测结果关卡,不改代码。页面入口处已有的那层保障继续作为唯一保障。
- 没有采纳的做法:再把组件库本身也补一遍。它只服务「别人把组件库装进自己的页面、又走普通 http」这种还没出现的用法。
- 后续:云端托管的页面是否带同样的保障,另立云端车道卡去查。

## Ruling parameters

1. This card closes as not planned, with no code change. The seat that holds the claim writes the closing note and closes it.
2. The host page script stays the one guarantee for a non-secure origin. Its two pin tests stay as they are. No shared id helper is added and no export is added (Clause-②: no change).
3. The closing note records the library-level finding below, so that a later reader finds it.
4. The cloud-hosted Console page was not measured. The seat files that check as a parked cloud-lane card (`domain:cloud`, `status:parked`, `repo:cloud`), under the maintainer's standing line 「需要转给 cloud的，应该立 cloud 车道卡」.
5. The empty branch `claude/issue-35645-random-uuid-fallback` is the seat's to delete.
6. Option B is not taken, and it is not ruled out for good. A report from somebody who renders the `@object-ui` packages outside the Console on plain http is the condition for a new card. That card would build the helper on `crypto.getRandomValues` only, with no weaker fallback, which is the host script's own rule.

## Measurement by the decision thread (base `origin/main` a5a5312f, Chromium)

- **The symptom is absent in the released product.** hotcrm main pins every `@objectstack/*` package at 18.6.0. It was built and served by `objectstack start -p 4001`, and opened at `http://192.0.2.2:4001` (`isSecureContext === false`), signed in. On the Accounts list, one click on the "Account Name" header reorders the rows A to Z and sends `GET /api/v1/data/crm_account?…sort=name`. A second click reorders Z to A with `sort=-name`. Zero page errors. The page was served under the real nonce CSP, so the dev's static read of the nonce stamping is now a measurement.
- **The host script is what makes it work.** Same server and address, with the script body stripped from the document in flight: `typeof crypto.randomUUID` is `undefined`, and the Accounts list does not render at all ("Something went wrong · crypto.randomUUID is not a function"). The throwing frame is our own `toSortItems`, called for the list's initial state, in chunk `plugins-views`.
- **The script predates the card.** `@objectstack/console@18.6.0` (published 2026-11-18) carries it in `dist/index.html`. The card was filed 2026-11-19, from a repro on `about:blank`.
- **Call sites:** 10 bare calls in 5 files, as the dev counted. One correction: `@object-ui/app-shell` is private, so 8 of the 10 are in the three published packages (components, plugin-list, plugin-view).
- **Library-level finding, for the closing note:** in a host without the script, on plain http, the fault is larger than this card says. A list whose view has a configured sort does not render at all.
- **One argument in the dev report is not relied on:** "the script reaches vendored chunks a helper cannot". In the 18.6.0 bundle every third-party caller (the code editor, the uuid library, the error reporter) already guards the call, so there is no such instance today.
- **Not measured:** the cloud-hosted page; browsers other than Chromium. The two pin test files were not re-run by this thread (dev reading: 20 passed).

Analysis and readings: `/mnt/project-files/pm-orders/objectstack/35645-decision-analysis.md` and `/mnt/project-files/pm-orders/objectstack/35645-readings/` (screenshots and the two probe scripts).

Release: area a4-F · releases claim 7073243557 · the card closes; the assignee and `pm:dispatched` come off in the same stroke. The empty probe branch `claude/issue-35645-random-uuid-fallback` (no commits, no PR) is deleted.

## What was measured

- **The released Console does not show the symptom.** `@objectstack/console@18.6.0` (published 2026-11-18T00:00Z, before this card) ships the inline host script `installInsecureOriginRandomUuid` in `dist/index.html` (objectui#4563; source `ui/apps/console/index.html`, pinned by `ui/apps/console/src/__tests__/insecure-origin-crypto.test.ts` and `insecure-origin-crypto.placement.test.ts`). On a plain-http, non-localhost origin (Chromium, `isSecureContext === false`), a header click on the Accounts list sorts A to Z and then Z to A with zero page errors (dev report 7073331953; decision thread readings in record 7073468878). That host script is the one guarantee, and it stays.
- **Library-level finding, kept here for a later reader.** In a page WITHOUT that host script, on plain http, the fault is larger than this card says: a list whose view has a configured sort does not render at all ("crypto.randomUUID is not a function", thrown from our own `toSortItems` for the list's initial state). The bare calls are 10 in 5 files; 8 of them are in the published packages `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/plugin-list` and `@object-ui/plugin-view` (`@object-ui/app-shell` is private).
- **Not measured here:** the cloud-hosted Console page. That check moves to #36248 (a parked cloud-lane card).

## When to reopen

If anyone reports rendering the `@object-ui` packages outside the Console on plain http, open a new card under ruling parameter 6 of record 7073468878: one shared id helper built on `crypto.getRandomValues` only, with no weaker fallback (the host script's own rule), replacing the bare calls.
